question: Who among the following is an exponent of the classical instrument, Santoor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Shivkumar Sharma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is an exponent of the **classical instrument, Santoor.**
 
• He is a renowned **musician and composer** who has contributed immensely to** Indian classical music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Santoor **is a** hammered dulcimer**-like instrument that originated in** Kashmir.**

 
 
• It is played by striking the strings with a pair of **light wooden mallets.**
 
 
 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva **was known for his unconventional approach to classical music.
 
 
• He experimented with different genres and styles and was known for his** innovative compositions.**
 
 
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi **was a disciple of **Sawai Gandharva** and was known for his mastery over the Kirana Gharana style of music.
 
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna, **India's highest civilian award, in** 2008.**
 
 
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar **was a** sitar maestro** who collaborated with numerous Western musicians and popularized Indian classical music in the West.
 
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna in 1999.**
